title: The kbroot docs say what the code does after this sprint: the reason line, and the hook's triggers
goal: kb/_self/tools.md, plugin.md and the kbroot.py docstring say that a failed git command reports its reason line (the ! [rejected] line of a refused push, hint: lines left out), and that fetch --hook fetches a root with no clone, or an old stamp, or a changed url, ref or pin (any of them, not all) (SP-c6w5hjmc review gap 5)

run:
import os, re, sys, tempfile, time, types
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import kbcommon, kbroot
bad = []
# behaviour: a refused push reports the rejected line, not the last line of git output; hint lines are left out
p = types.SimpleNamespace(url="https://example.invalid/r.git", name="r")
err = "hint: Updates were rejected\n! [rejected]        HEAD -> main (fetch first)\nerror: failed to push some refs to https://example.invalid/r.git\nhint: pull first\n"
kbroot.run_bounded = lambda args, cwd, timeout: types.SimpleNamespace(returncode=1, stderr=err, stdout="")
ok, why = kbroot.git(["push"], p)
if ok or "[rejected]" not in why or "hint" in why:
    bad.append("git() gave the reason " + repr(why))
# behaviour: fetch --hook fetches a root with no clone, or an old stamp, or a changed url, ref or pin
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
kbcommon.pointer_root_dir = lambda q: os.path.join(d, "clone")
kbcommon.roots_cache_dir = lambda: d
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, "clone"))
q = types.SimpleNamespace(name="r", url="u", ref="main", pin="")
now = time.time()
if not kbroot.stale(q, now):
    bad.append("a root with no root file counts as fetched")
open(os.path.join(d, "clone", kbcommon.ROOT_FILE), "w").write("x")
open(os.path.join(d, "r.fetched"), "w").write(kbroot.fingerprint(q))
if kbroot.stale(q, now):
    bad.append("a fresh stamp of the same pointer counts as stale")
for field, value in (("url", "u2"), ("ref", "dev"), ("pin", "abc")):
    r = types.SimpleNamespace(**{**vars(q), field: value})
    if not kbroot.stale(r, now):
        bad.append("a changed " + field + " is not stale")
if not kbroot.stale(q, now + kbroot.HOOK_MAX_AGE_S + 60):
    bad.append("an old stamp is not stale")
# docs: the reason line, and the triggers as any one of them
tools_row = next((l for l in open("kb/_self/tools.md", encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines() if l.startswith("| `python3 _tools/kbroot.py list`")), "")
plugin_hook = next((l for l in open("kb/_self/plugin.md", encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines() if "kbroot.py fetch --hook" in l), "")
doc = kbroot.__doc__ or ""
windows = {
    "tools.md": tools_row[tools_row.find("`fetch --hook` is"):][:700],
    "plugin.md": plugin_hook,
    "kbroot.py": doc[doc.find("kbroot.py fetch --hook"):][:700],
}
if "last line" in tools_row or "rejected" not in tools_row:
    bad.append("tools.md kbroot row does not give the reason line")
if "rejected" not in doc:
    bad.append("the kbroot.py docstring does not give the reason line")
for name, text in windows.items():
    if not (re.search(r"no clone", text) and re.search(r"\burl\b", text) and re.search(r"\bpin\b", text) and re.search(r"\b(any|one) of\b", text)):
        bad.append(name + " does not say the hook fetches a root with no clone, an old stamp, or a changed url, ref or pin, any one of them")
print("; ".join(bad) or "ok")
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

clauses.clause: kb/_self/tools.md, plugin.md and the kbroot.py docstring say that a failed git command reports its reason line (the ! [rejected] line of a refused push, hint: lines left out)
that fetch --hook fetches a root with no clone, or an old stamp, or a changed url, ref or pin (any of them, not all) (SP-c6w5hjmc review gap 5)
